evidence.description: STATIC corroboration only (not chain proof): netWorth computes moonwell as (mt * ex / 1e18) / 1e6 using exchangeRateStored(), which already encodes the 8-dec cToken / 6-dec underlying scaling — so the live dashboard math is consistent with 'mUSDC is 8-dec and ~$1 real'. The cToken interface (exchangeRateStored on 0xEdc817) vs ERC4626 interface (convertToAssets on 0xbeef) usage also corroborates M=Moonwell / V=Morpho. This makes the decimals conclusion PLAUSIBLE on disk, but the mandated live decimals()/balanceOf RPC consensus could NOT be re-run by the adversary, and an UNRECONCILED contradicting on-disk record (revenue-dashboard spec lines 122-124) still labels the same addresses the OPPOSITE way and still asserts a morpho phantom — so the conclusion is NOT independently confirmed.

depositLanded is pure bigint: rejects !statusOk, surplus<=0, moved<=0, and moved < 99% of surplus. No I/O. Boundary (990000 pass / 989999 fail) and negative-delta and surplus-0 cases are all handled. Sound defensive logic.

liqAfter is read AFTER both the primary and Fluid-fallback deposit paths; recordDeposit is gated on `landed` and records Number(liquid - liqAfter)/1e6 (the actual moved delta), not the blind surplus. Output line emits phantom:true when status ok but not landed. Wiring matches the contract.

Static contract tests pin the import, the `if (landed) recordDeposit` gate, the absence of the old `if (r.status===success) recordDeposit` pattern, and the moved-delta basis. These would catch a regression re-wiring to status-gating.

revenueBySource = value - cost per venue, hides venues where BOTH value<1e-4 AND cost<1e-4 (so a fully-empty venue with no basis never surfaces), and adds realised earnBySource. Pure, no I/O. telemetry-poster delegates to it (lines 11,76), so the daemon's P&L is the unit-tested path.

Tests assert REAL behavior: both real positions (morpho & moonwell) net |P&L|<0.01 against their basis; beefy (0 value, no basis) hidden; PHANTOM sentinel: injecting a basis key with no on-chain position yields a fake < -0.9 loss (the exact thing deposit-guard prevents); realised x402 earning lifts total by exactly the sale amount. Bidirectional and behavioral, not tautological.

Static count of `^test(` in the 4 *.test.mjs files matched by the documented glob = 9+3+5+4 = 21. The reviewer could NOT execute `node --test` (Bash unavailable), so PASS/FAIL of the suite is UNVERIFIED this round and cannot be claimed. The glob `*.test.mjs` excludes oxwork.test.js/swap.test.js (.js), so the documented command runs exactly 21 tests.

The fix-phantom spec DOES truthfully record the three wrong turns (round 1 drop-morpho, round 2 drop-moonwell, round 3 it-was-a-decimals-bug-revert-all) verbatim and labels them honestly as caught by the adversary. That part is honest.
